target.statement: cDPO with Llama-3-8B achieves 67.9% accuracy on GSM8K, outperforming baselines.

compute.basis: Requires training multiple 8B models (positive, negative, cDPO) with LoRA on GSM8K, which is infeasible on CPU and needs significant GPU memory and time.

blockers: needs GPU with at least 80GB VRAM for training 8B models
requires training multiple models (positive, negative, cDPO) and sampling 64 rollouts per problem
no CPU-only path; training and inference of 8B models on CPU would take weeks
